description: Before you pay or fund escrow: CAPPZ checks the other side (can the address receive, how old is it, its marketplace record and mandate, can you afford it) and returns ok / warn / stop with reasons, signed. Costs 0.01 XRP from your wallet. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

amount.description: What you intend to send (in XRP, or in --currency): also checks you can afford it with escrow reserves.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

currency.description: CAPPZ or USD-tokenZ/1 (RLUSD): also checks both trust lines, the issuer's freeze and authorization settings, and whether the token can be escrowed.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

legs.description: Escrow legs the payment will use (default 1).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

target.description: The XRPL address (r…) you will pay, or a marketplace party id (p-…).

name: market_check
